_comment: Client portfolio: the single source for the portfolio on /case-studies, the featured clients on the home page and the company profile on each case study page. Rendered by chrome/clients.py and chrome/build_case_pages.py; checked by chrome/clients.py --check. The two orders are fixed by the owner (portfolio 2026-11-22; home page revised 2026-11-22 for iteration 5): never alphabetize. 'text' says whether a description was supplied by the owner or is a proposal awaiting review. 'include': false removes a client everywhere. 'approved' stays null until the owner gives final approval of names and logos; golive_check.py fails until then.

lisi-aerospace.name: LISI Aerospace
lisi-aerospace.description: LISI Aerospace is an international aerospace manufacturing organization specializing in advanced fastening systems, assembly technologies and precision structural components. As a division of the publicly traded LISI Group, the company operates manufacturing facilities across multiple continents and serves major aircraft manufacturers worldwide, contributing to the development of next-generation aviation technologies.
lisi-aerospace.ownership: A division of LISI Group, listed on Euronext Paris.
lisi-aerospace.engagement: IT administration taken over and stabilized, then carried through the move to remote work.

cunico.name: Cunico Corporation / BWX Technologies
cunico.description: Cunico Corporation specializes in the engineering and manufacturing of mission-critical valves, manifolds and fluid control components for naval defense and marine applications. Acquired in 2022 by BWX Technologies, a major nuclear technology and defense contractor, Cunico supports highly specialized applications across naval nuclear propulsion, submarines, surface vessels and commercial maritime operations.
cunico.ownership: Acquired by BWX Technologies, Inc. (BWXT) in April 2022. Our engagement is with Cunico; BWXT’s wider technology environment is outside it.
cunico.engagement: Outsourced IT and technology governance across Cunico’s sites, through its integration into BWXT.

philip-morris-international.name: Philip Morris International
philip-morris-international.description: Philip Morris International is a publicly traded multinational corporation with extensive global operations across manufacturing, research, product development and distribution. The organization has also pursued diversification into pharmaceutical and inhalation technologies, including its acquisition of respiratory drug development company OtiTopic in 2021.
philip-morris-international.engagement: Pro Link Systems participated in a project-based engagement involving Philip Morris International.

m13.name: M13
m13.description: Founded in 2016 by entrepreneurs Carter and Courtney Reum, M13 is a venture capital firm focused on investing in and accelerating innovative technology companies. Its investment history includes prominent businesses such as Ring, Lyft, Pinterest, ClassPass and Thrive Market. M13 combines venture investment with operational expertise to support entrepreneurs building and scaling transformative businesses.
m13.engagement: The firm’s founding technology and communications platform, designed and built for a growing venture portfolio.

fralock.name: Fralock Holdings
fralock.description: Established in 1967, Fralock specializes in the engineering and manufacturing of advanced materials, high-performance components and precision assemblies. Its technologies support demanding applications across aerospace, defense, semiconductor manufacturing, medical devices, electronics and energy. The company serves major corporations, government organizations and original equipment manufacturers requiring high-reliability engineering solutions.
fralock.ownership: Arsenal Capital Partners, a private equity firm, acquired a majority interest in 2018.
fralock.engagement: Network, security and IT operations unified across sites and newly acquired subsidiaries in several states.

marriott-hotels.name: Marriott Hotels
marriott-hotels.description: Marriott Hotels is part of Marriott International, one of the world’s largest hospitality organizations, with a global portfolio spanning luxury hotels, resorts, full-service accommodations and extended-stay properties.
marriott-hotels.engagement: Pro Link Systems participated in a technology project involving a Marriott hotel property, adding to our experience within the hospitality sector.

veev-spirits.name: VEEV Spirits
veev-spirits.description: Founded by entrepreneurs Carter and Courtney Reum in 2007, VEEV Spirits introduced an innovative portfolio of premium spirits and organic ready-to-drink cocktails. The Los Angeles-based company established a national presence before being acquired by Luxco in 2016, marking a successful entrepreneurial exit in the competitive beverage industry.
veev-spirits.engagement: Technology designed and run from the founders’ home through multi-state expansion.
metric: from inception to a multi-state operation

optical-zonu.name: Optical Zonu Corporation
optical-zonu.description: Optical Zonu Corporation is a specialized technology manufacturer focused on advanced fiber-optic communications and radio frequency transmission systems. Its engineering solutions support telecommunications infrastructure, satellite communications, aerospace, defense, public safety and enterprise networks, addressing complex requirements for high-performance optical data and signal transmission.
optical-zonu.engagement: Primary IT management team, including domain and DNS management.

cochise-capital.name: Cochise Capital
cochise-capital.description: Cochise Capital is a Los Angeles-based private investment firm founded by Mike Talla and Rex Licklider. With more than four decades of real estate investment experience and reported capital under management exceeding $1.2 billion, the firm specializes in multifamily investments, property development and value-add real estate opportunities across strategically selected coastal markets.

crr.name: CR&R Environmental Services
crr.description: CR&R Environmental Services is an established environmental services organization specializing in waste collection, recycling, resource recovery and sustainable waste management. Through its extensive operational infrastructure and multiple business divisions, the company provides essential environmental services to residential, commercial, industrial and municipal customers.
crr.engagement: De facto CIO: cybersecurity, cloud and network standards unified across divisions.

global-holdings.name: Global Holdings
global-holdings.description: Global Holdings was a Southern California healthcare organization operating an extensive network of diagnostic medical imaging facilities, specializing in MRI, CT scanning and advanced radiological services. During its operations, the organization maintained 19 owned facilities and an extensive network of affiliated healthcare providers, delivering diagnostic imaging services across a complex, multi-location healthcare environment.
global-holdings.ownership: Dissolved in 2021, when its facilities were sold.
global-holdings.engagement: Network, AWS imaging platform and secure patient portal, designed and operated by Pro Link Systems.
metric: owned facilities on one network and imaging platform

otitopic.name: OtiTopic
otitopic.description: Founded in 2012, OtiTopic was a pharmaceutical research and development company specializing in inhaled therapeutic technologies. Its research included patented drug delivery systems and the development of an investigational inhalable aspirin treatment intended for cardiovascular emergencies. In August 2021, OtiTopic was acquired by Philip Morris International as part of its expansion into pharmaceutical innovation.

fsc-lighting.name: FSC Lighting
fsc-lighting.description: Established in 1969, FSC Lighting is a California-based manufacturer specializing in energy-efficient commercial and industrial lighting technologies. With more than five decades of manufacturing experience, the company develops customized LED lighting systems and integrated lighting controls for commercial, industrial and institutional facilities, supporting both modernization initiatives and new construction projects.
fsc-lighting.engagement: Network overhauled across offices and production facilities, with cloud systems and centralized data management.

hallmark-lighting.name: Hallmark Lighting
hallmark-lighting.description: Hallmark Lighting has a longstanding history of designing and manufacturing custom lighting solutions for the upscale hospitality industry. Established in Southern California, the company has worked with hospitality designers, purchasing organizations and hotel developers to deliver specialized architectural lighting and decorative fixtures for luxury hotel construction and renovation projects.
hallmark-lighting.ownership: Acquired in 2016 by Resilience Capital Partners, together with its sister company Luminance.
hallmark-lighting.engagement: IT rebuilt from the ground up, connecting California design teams with an overseas plant.

myx-fusions.name: MYX Fusions
myx-fusions.description: MYX Fusions is a beverage brand known for its fruit-infused Moscato wines and distinctive approach to consumer marketing. Through its partnership with internationally recognized recording artist Nicki Minaj and entertainment entrepreneur Mona Scott-Young, the brand combined beverage innovation with popular culture, expanding its distribution into international markets.
myx-fusions.ownership: A brand of MYX Beverage LLC.

beverly-hills-plaza.name: Beverly Hills Plaza Hotel & Spa
beverly-hills-plaza.description: Located along Wilshire Boulevard, Beverly Hills Plaza Hotel & Spa is an upscale boutique hospitality property serving leisure travelers, business professionals and extended-stay guests. The hotel offers luxury accommodations, residential-style suites, dining and spa facilities, combining traditional hospitality with the personalized experience of an independent luxury property.
beverly-hills-plaza.engagement: Dial-up data ports replaced with high-speed coverage across the hotel, and a custom application that posted internet charges to guest folios.

cookes-crating.name: Cooke’s Crating & Fine Arts Transportation
cookes-crating.description: Established in 1975, Cooke’s Crating is a respected fine art transportation, storage and installation company serving museums, galleries, collectors and cultural institutions internationally. Its extensive portfolio includes work involving the J. Paul Getty Museum, the Huntington, the Museum of Contemporary Art and numerous other prominent cultural institutions. The company specializes in the handling, transportation and preservation of valuable artwork and museum collections.
cookes-crating.engagement: Moved off a former provider’s locked infrastructure with zero downtime, then modernized.

optimus-property-management.name: Optimus Property Management
optimus-property-management.description: Established in 2007, Optimus Property Management is a Los Angeles-based real estate management organization specializing in residential and commercial properties. Its diverse portfolio encompasses multifamily communities, office buildings and retail centers, supported by comprehensive property operations, leasing, financial reporting and asset management services.

global-garden.name: Global Garden
global-garden.description: Global Garden is a North American wholesale distributor specializing in advanced horticultural and controlled-environment agriculture solutions. Serving retailers and commercial cultivation operations throughout the United States and Canada, the company provides specialized lighting, plant nutrition, hydroponic equipment and infrastructure solutions designed to improve cultivation efficiency and productivity.
global-garden.engagement: Managed IT, including email security across the organization’s mailboxes.

waverly-school.name: The Waverly School
waverly-school.description: The Waverly School is an independent, accredited educational institution in Pasadena, California, serving students from preschool through 12th grade. Operating across three campuses, the school provides a progressive, college-preparatory educational experience emphasizing intellectual development, creativity, critical thinking and social responsibility.
waverly-school.engagement: Day-to-day IT for the school, including Google Workspace for staff and student accounts.
metric: as the school’s outsourced IT department

snitzer-law.name: Law Offices of Alan B. Snitzer
snitzer-law.description: The Law Offices of Alan B. Snitzer is an established California legal practice specializing in workers’ compensation and personal injury law. Led by an attorney practicing since 1978, the firm brings decades of legal experience to representing individuals navigating complex legal matters throughout Southern California.
snitzer-law.engagement: From an on-premises data center to the cloud, with the infrastructure for every office move handled.
metric: of the firm’s environment on Microsoft Azure

Our experience spans investment management, manufacturing, biotechnology, professional services, real estate, hospitality and consumer products.
